INTRODUCTION
Zyro Dynamics is committed to providing all employees with a clear understanding of their compensation and
benefits, and to maintaining a motivated, high-performing workforce by offering competitive rewards. The
Company operates a compensation structure that aims to achieve fairness and equity for similar roles within the
organisation, create appropriate differentials across grade levels, provide strong incentives for high performance,
and remain competitive with the Indian IT product industry.
The confidentiality of individual compensation details and employment contract terms is to be strictly maintained
at all times. Employees must not disclose their compensation to colleagues, as violations of this principle may
attract disciplinary action.
SALARY PAYMENT AND PAYROLL
Salaries and professional fees are processed and credited to the employee's registered bank account by the 7th
of the following month. Any changes to payment dates for a given month will be communicated to employees in
advance by the Payroll team.
Payroll Cut-Off Date
The payroll cut-off date is the 24th of each month. Any leave without pay, new joinings, or separations after the
24th will be adjusted in the subsequent month's payroll cycle. New employees joining after the 24th will still
receive their salary for that month on the standard payday, with the salary calculated on a pro-rata basis.

SALARY DEDUCTIONS
The Company may make deductions from an employee's salary in the following circumstances:
  Leave without pay in the current payroll period.
 Recovery of mistaken overpayment of salary from a previous period.
 Contributions towards statutory funds such as Provident Fund and ESIC, as applicable.
 Income tax deducted at source (TDS) based on the investment declarations submitted by the employee at
the beginning of the financial year.
 Recovery of salary advances, loans, or equipment costs as per the agreement at the time of issuance.
 Recovery of notice pay shortfall in the event that an employee does not serve the full notice period on
resignation.
Note: Zyro Dynamics ensures that no deduction will cause an employee's net salary to fall below the applicable statutory
minimum wage for their location.

STATUTORY BONUS
Employees whose gross monthly salary is at or below Rs. 21,000 (or such other amount as may be prescribed
under law from time to time) and who have worked for at least 30 days in a financial year are eligible for a
Statutory Bonus as per the Payment of Bonus Act, 1965. The Statutory Bonus may be included as a component
in the CTC and paid monthly or on an annual basis between April and November of the following financial year.
BENEFITS AND PERKS
Health and Insurance
  Group Medical Insurance: Coverage of up to Rs. 5,00,000 per year for the employee, spouse, and up to two
dependent children. All premiums are fully paid by the Company.
 Personal Accident Insurance: Coverage equivalent to 5 times the employee's annual CTC.
 Term Life Insurance: Coverage of 3 times the annual CTC for all permanent employees.
Retirement Benefits
  Provident Fund: Both the employee and the Company contribute 12% of the employee's basic salary each
month to the PF account. This is managed by the Payroll team and credited as per EPFO guidelines.
 Gratuity: Payable to employees who have completed 5 or more years of continuous service, calculated and
paid as per the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972.
Wellness and Lifestyle
  Annual Wellness Allowance of Rs. 12,000, available at Rs. 1,000 per month for gym memberships, fitness
apps, health check-ups, or mental health consultations.
 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP): Up to 6 free and confidential counselling sessions per year through
the Company's EAP partner.
 Employee Stock Options (ESOP): Offered to employees at grade L5 and above, with a 4-year vesting
schedule on a 1-year cliff basis.
